## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? What's the pain point?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the expected behavior and functionality this feature will provide.

## Suggested Approach _(optional)_

If known, describe the technical implementation plan: which files/modules
to modify, the pipeline stages involved, and any patterns to follow.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Feature behaves as described in the proposed solution
- [ ] Prioriza bajo consumo de CPU sobre sofisticación de la detección
- [ ] No regressions in `ojota status` or a real detection

## References

Links to related issues, documentation, or relevant resources.
